FINANCE COMMITTEE
MINUTES

‘A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Monday, September 19, 2022, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Jeff White, Chairman, Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Ken Esquibel, and
Richard Johnson (via Zoom).

AGENDA ITEMS

20. RESOLUTION ~ Reappropriating the Fiscal Year 2023 Budget of the City of Cheyenne
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16-4-112 & 16-4-113. (SPONSOR - MR. WHITE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend by substitute
dated September 13, 2022, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion to amend carried by unanimous
voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Robin Lockman, City Treasurer, provided a staff report and presented a substitute amendment to
include changes requested by the Board of Public Utilities. Committee members Dr. Aldrich and
Mr. Johnson commented on the item.

22. RESOLUTION ~ Expressing the will of the Governing Body directing the Mayor to hire a
Projects Manager to assist the City of Cheyenne in managing and coordinating
certain 6" Penny Tax Projects and other City project priorities. (SPONSOR - MR.
SEGRAVE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend by substitute
dated September 6, 2022, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Amendment carried with Dr. Aldrich and
Mr. Esquibel voting “YES” and Mr. Johnson voting “NO”. Main motion, as amended, carried
with Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Esquibel voting “YES” and Mr. Johnson voting “NO”.

Ward If Councilman Tom Segrave, and sponsor of the item, provided an overview of the resolution
and presented a substitute amendment. Kris Jones, City Clerk, Robin Lockman, City Treasurer,
and Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided additional information.
Committee members Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Johnson commented on the item.

23. RESOLUTION ~ Expressing the will of the Governing Body to prioritize and adequately
fund specified Downtown 6" Penny Tax Maintenance and Improvement Projects.
(SPONSORS — DR. ALDRICH, MR. LAYBOURN, MR. ROYBAL, MR. SEGRAVE &
MR. WHITE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
